blocking_findings: Subclass-specific record identity is omitted from canonical IDs.
Empty source revisions are accepted and extraction emits revision-less spans.
SQLite round-trip drops envelope fields and can reclassify rejected records.
Mixed runs/schema versions are not rejected at storage or retrieval boundaries.
Partial generations can be marked complete without completeness proof.
Retrieval lacks absolute ceilings and admissibility/status checks.
Malformed Unicode can crash extraction instead of abstaining.
Documented python -m pytest command fails without PYTHONPATH.
No true end-to-end canary test exists; current stage representations are incompatible.
disposition: repair_wave_open; no release or push claim
next_gate: independent verification after repairs are integrated
